podcast.body: According to a UK survey that analyzed playlists containing keywords like "bathroom," "toilet," and "pooping," "Sweater Weather" by The Neighbourhood was identified as the most popular song to listen to while sitting on the toilet. This unusual finding suggests its widespread use in private moments. "The number one song was sweater weather by the neighborhood."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
